key

The key property is the unique identifier assigned to a FeatureCell at registration time. It is used by the Vault runtime to identify, route, and attribute state, errors, and lifecycle events.

Property Contract Summary

  • The key is assigned during FeatureCell registration
  • The key is immutable and read-only
  • Each FeatureCell key must be unique
  • The key identifies the FeatureCell across the Vault runtime

The key property does not participate in pipeline execution or state computation. It exists solely to provide stable identity for the FeatureCell.

Example

Example: Key

{{`this.vault.initialize();

console.info(this.vault.key)`}}
 
{{`employeeCell.initialize();

console.info(employeeCell.key)`}}
Property
Property Description
key: string Unique identifier assigned to the FeatureCell. The key is defined during registration and remains constant for the lifetime of the FeatureCell.
